reasons.persona_fit: Fits the 1–10 person business audience with calm, restrained tone and human-in-the-loop discipline, though it briefly uses 'I' rather than the standard public 'we'.
reasons.clarity: The core argument is immediately clear, distinguishing gut feel from repeatable data trails with transparent, plain-English logic.
reasons.actionability: Outlines a clear, manual diagnostic next step (reviewing one month of lapses to find common signals) before touching any automation.
reasons.factual_grounding: Strictly grounded; makes no claims of customer results, benchmarks, or pre-built churn prediction capabilities.
